description: Two processes. Process b opens the source with DAO OpenDatabase in each of four states (shared read/write, exclusive read/write, exclusive read-only, shared read-only), for the rich ACCDB and then the rich MDB; while b holds each state process a runs CompactDatabase of that source to a new file and reads DBEngine.Errors and the output's row count; b releases before the next state.
